description: Krovi main window and the Circle to Ask selection overlay. Least privilege: every window mutation (size, position, show/hide, focus, click-through) is done by the Rust modules (shell, circle), never by the webview. The webviews only need events (shell-mode / shell-request / circle-arm / circle-result / aware-state) plus the app's own commands. The `circle` window is created on demand by src-tauri/src/circle.rs and only ever loads the bundled overlay page (#circle).
